messages:
Maria C.: hey team :wave: quick Q  manager submitted an off-cycle contractor->FTE conversion and promotion yesterday after the payroll cutoff. they want retro pay to the conversion date and immediate benefits enrollment. what actually happens for taxes/benefits and do we need a special ticket?
Jamal: short answer: we can do retro pay but benefits enrollment depends on the benefits cutoff and employee type change. need evidence + approval.
Alex R.: @Jamal what evidence specifically? manager uploaded a Google doc but not the signed offer. will that block benefits?
Jamal: signed offer is mandatory for benefits change. for retro pay we need the approved comp sheet + effective date in HRIS. if cutoff missed, payroll will process next cycle and we issue a retro adjustment.
Lisa (Payroll): FYI payroll timeline: cutoff was 10:00 PT yesterday. since submission was after cutoff, base pay change won't hit this pay period. retro steps: 1) confirm effective_date in HRIS 2) submit retro payroll adjustment ticket to payroll queue 3) tag as 'off-cycle-conversion' for tax handling.
PayrollBot: To submit retro adjustment, run:
```
/payroll create-retro --user maria.employee --effective 2026-03-01 --reason "contractor->FTE conversion" --amount 1234.56
```
then attach approval PDF.
Maria C.: OK thanks   who files the ticket? manager or People Ops?
Jamal: People Ops files once we have signed offer + comp approval doc. manager can attach files to the ticket (preferred). I can draft the ticket and ask manager to confirm.
Alex R.: question on taxes: will retro trigger supplementary tax withholding or is it lumped into year-to-date?
Lisa (Payroll): retro pay is processed as supplemental wages; state tax handling varies. payroll will run withholding per state rules. we also need the new hire's W-4/withholding confirmation if not already on file.
Maria C.: noted. also benefits: if signed offer says benefits effective on conversion date but enrollment window closed, do we do an exception?
Jamal: benefits exceptions allowed for FTE conversion if approved by People Ops + Benefits lead. need signed offer and evidence of date. Benefits team will backdate coverage start if approved, but some carriers have strict timelines   we escalate those immediately.
Maria C.: cool   I'll collect the signed offer and comp sheet, tag @Jamal, upload to ticket. thanks y'all :pray:
Jamal: sounds good. I'll prepare the People Ops approval bundle and ping Benefits.
Alex R.: adding checklist for the ticket to be safe:
- signed offer (pdf)
- manager approval email (screenshot)
- comp approval doc (signed)
- target effective date
- employee W-4 or withholding confirmation
- any equity grant paperwork if applicable
Maria C.: perfect. I'll open the ticket and put those attachments. will update here when done.
PeopleOps-Bot: reminder   please include employee ID in the ticket title to avoid processing delays.
Maria C.: done, ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-8791   attached offer + comp sheet. tagging @Jamal for review.
Jamal: got it, reviewing now. ETA on People Ops approval ~2 business days unless Benefits carrier needs extra info.
Lisa (Payroll): once approved, I'll queue the retro payroll run and confirm tax treatment. will post the payroll ticket ID in this thread.
Maria C.: thanks everyone, closing loop later.
